# Environment models

All models in this folder are by **Kenney** (https://kenney.nl), released under **CC0 1.0** (public domain).

| File | Source |
| --- | --- |
| palm-long, palm-short, formation-large-stone, formation-stone | Kenney models mirrored in pmndrs/market-assets (https://github.com/pmndrs/market-assets) |

They were converted from Draco-compressed glTF to plain GLB (no decoder needed at runtime).
Colors are re-tinted in game.

Characters, buildings, trees, rocks, clouds and props are KayKit (see `../kk/CREDITS.md`).
Guns are from the Styloo Guns Asset Pack (see `../guns/CREDITS.md`).
